articles.title: The Fed has bought over $90B in Treasury bills since December. Why this has a huge impact on your finances.
articles.summary: The Treasury Deparment said Wednesday that the Federal Reserve has bought more than $90 billion of short-dated government bills over the past eight weeks.

articles.title: These hot S&P 500 stocks show where investors are heading as they run away from tech
articles.summary: The industrials sector has been a big beneficiary of the rotation out of tech, with a number of defense and transportation stocks hitting new highs on Wednesday.

articles.title: Qualcomm’s stock falls as memory constraints hit outlook
articles.summary: Tech companies across the board are feeling the sting of memory-chip shortages, and Qualcomm just showed it’s no exception.

articles.title: This trucker is finally seeing signs of a bottom, and providing a boost to transport stocks
articles.summary: Old Dominion’s stock surged into record territory after saying a long freight recession may finally be ending, and is helping provide a boost to the overall transportation sector.

articles.title: Software ate the world. Now, Wall Street is worried AI will eat software.
articles.summary: Investors have quickly moved to sell shares of companies that looked like they could be on the menu

articles.title: Soybean prices surge to highest level this year, as Trump surprises market with plan for more sales to China
articles.summary: The sort of buying President Trump outlined from China seems “unlikely on many fronts, but neither can the possibility be ignored,” analyst says.

articles.title: E.l.f. Beauty’s more upbeat outlook shows demand for cosmetics is still growing
articles.summary: E.l.f. Beauty’s stock surged after a raised outlook for both sales and profit, as demand for cosmetics keeps growing.

articles.title: SpaceX rivals AST SpaceMobile and Rocket Lab join space-stock selloff
articles.summary: Losses could be tied in part to this week’s software rout, according to one analyst.

articles.title: Lilly says Mounjaro and Zepbound sales more than doubled, as stock rallies
articles.summary: Eli Lilly became the first pharmaceutical stock to reach a $1 trillion valuation late last year.

articles.title: Powell probe will get resolved, clearing the way for Warsh’s confirmation, key Republican senator says
articles.summary: Senate Banking Committee Chair Tim Scott indicated Wednesday that he expects the Department of Justice will resolve its criminal probe of current Federal Reserve chief Jerome Powell, clearing a path for the panel to advance President Donald Trump’s nominee for the top Fed job, Kevin Warsh.
